content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user","i_want":"to edit an existing task and save my changes","so_that":"my task list reflects the current state of my work","business_description":"The user can change the details of a task that already exists. The same form used to create a task is reused in edit mode. The backend validates the changed values and returns a success or error result, and the frontend shows that result only after the backend confirms the change.","business_value":"Users can correct and maintain their tasks without deleting and recreating them, which keeps the task list accurate.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"an existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"the user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"the backend stores the new title and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"an existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"the user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"the frontend receives the error response","then":"the frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns success","when":"the frontend receives the success response","then":"the frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"a task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"an update request is sent for that ID","then":"the backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"}],"edge_cases":["Update request for a task that was deleted by another session: the backend returns Task Not Found and the frontend shows an error message.","Title containing only spaces: the PRD does not say whether whitespace-only titles are empty; this is an open question.","Due Date equal to Creation Date: the PRD rejects only dates earlier than the Creation Date, so equal dates are accepted.","Update that fails with an internal server or database error: the frontend shows an error and does not show the task as updated.","Open question: the PRD does not state which fields are editable; whether Creation Date, Status and Completion Date can be changed through the update is not specified.","Open question: the PRD lists a Last Updated Date field but does not state that it must change on each update; this needs confirmation."],"dependencies":["US-create-task"],"definition_of_done":["Update endpoint accepts changes to a task by ID and returns the updated task on success.","Backend rejects an empty title and a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date with a validation error, and stores nothing in those cases.","Backend returns Task Not Found for an unknown ID and an error for invalid input, as defined by the shared error handling.","Frontend reuses the create/edit form in edit mode with the existing values pre-filled.","Frontend shows a success or error message after every update action.","Frontend does not show a task as updated until the backend returns success.","Open questions about editable fields and Last Updated Date are recorded and answered before release."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add update endpoint for a task by ID with validation and error responses","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Implement the update operation of the task endpoints: accept changed fields for an existing task ID, validate that the title is not empty and that the Due Date is not earlier than the Creation Date, store the change, and return the updated task. Return Task Not Found for unknown IDs and the shared error responses for invalid input and internal or database errors. Only the update operation is built here; create, read, delete and status change belong to other stories.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Endpoint updates an existing task and returns the updated task.","Empty title is rejected and nothing is stored.","Due Date earlier than Creation Date is rejected and nothing is stored.","Unknown task ID returns Task Not Found.","Invalid input and internal or database errors return the shared error format.","Unit tests cover each validation rule and error case."]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-form","title":"[FE] Reuse task form in edit mode with existing values pre-filled","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Extend the existing task creation/editing form so that it opens for an existing task with its current values filled in. On submit, call the update endpoint. Do not show the task as updated until the backend returns success. Show a success or error message after the update action.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9b30a145","R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0","R-bc3213df"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Edit form opens with the current values of the selected task.","Submit calls the update endpoint and waits for its response.","No success state is shown before the backend returns success.","A success message is shown after a successful update.","An error message is shown when the backend returns an error, and the displayed task is unchanged.","Empty title and past Due Date errors from the backend are shown next to the relevant field or as a message."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-tests","title":"[QA] Test suite for editing an existing task","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Write the test suite for the edit story covering the update endpoint, the edit form and the messages after each update action, including the rule that no optimistic success state is shown.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-9b30a145","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-d57336f7","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover a successful update, empty title rejection, Due Date rejection, Task Not Found and internal error cases.","Tests verify the success message appears only after backend success.","Tests verify the error message appears and the task is not shown as updated when the backend fails.","All tests pass in the continuous integration pipeline."]}]}
